snippet.title: Heartfall — A Tale in Three Lives | 3rd Life Fangame Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
https://heartfall.carrd.co/

In this fangame based on 3rd Life, play as Grian to discover the different ways fate can unfold!  Befriend allies, make enemies, and explore the world to see if the ending can be changed… 

Heartfall is a collaborative fangame sprint that ran applications in March 2026 and is now almost ready to be seen by the world!
The game is a visual novel RPG — explore a variety of new endings to 3rd life!

Every route begins with the choices you make in those first few days— from making new friends (or enemies) to exploring the island for secrets! The route teams made some shocking twists you would not expect...! 


Heartfall - a Tale in Three Lives is an independent and not-for-profit fan project. The game is unaffiliated with Grian and the 3rd Life SMP cast.

All content contained within are our own interpretations and do not represent the opinions, thoughts, or vision of the 3rd Life SMP cast.
